You cannot use `%ld` with an `int64_t`, because the size of a `long` is not fixed on all platforms. Use `%"PRId64"`.

Like this?

`snprintf(label, ITEM_LABEL_LENGTH, "%"PRId64".%02"PRId64"cm", p / 100, p % 100);`

The right most `%02ld` could just be cast down to int8 after modulo 100.
Fixed this, and also resolved the missing `gint64` cast in the dissector function. Tested it with `ffffff7f` and `00000080` to ensure high and low values outside of the int32 work.
